caption: The drawing consists of six cows arranged in two rows of three against a plain, light-colored background. Each cow is illustrated in shades of black, gray, and white, with unique brand markings prominently displayed on their sides. The brands include "JEB" on the upper left cow, a symbol resembling a square root sign on the upper right cow, a keyhole-like symbol on the lower left cow, "TOM" on the lower center cow, and a symbol combining a cross and a figure-eight on the lower right cow. In the center is a cow with a round target symbol on its side, being ridden by a person wearing a hat, vest, and pants, holding a rope while seated astride the cow. Each cow is standing on a patch of grass. Below the illustrations, the text reads: "DRAWINGS USED IN EARLY ARIZONA NEWS-PAPER BRAND ANNOUNCEMENTS." In the lower right corner, the name "Elizabeth Johnson" appears as the illustrator.
title: Newspaper Brand Announcements
